# Repository instructions

Read AGENTS.md before substantial changes.

Read HANDOFF.md for the current operational state.

Do not infer current project state from an old chat.

Keep AGENTS.md concise and permanent.
Keep current operational state in HANDOFF.md.

main is the published baseline.

Do not push, merge, force-push, destructively reset, or overwrite unrelated work without explicit user approval.

Before editing, verify repository path, branch, HEAD and clean/dirty state.

Keep creative sketches isolated.

Spout and NDI are optional output adapters and must not become dependencies of ordinary sketches.

For PowerShell instructions intended for direct user paste, provide complete blocks wrapped in & { ... }.

Update HANDOFF.md when validation status, blockers, architecture decisions or NEXT materially change.
